items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 24 September 2026 12:17pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 24 September 2026 at 11:50am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds developing.


##Synopsis##

High pressure to the east of England, and deep area of low pressure to the southwest of Iceland bringing a cold front overnight.


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 this afternoon, but remaining 4 in southeast waters. Then veering west or northwest 2 to 4 in all waters overnight. Backing west or southwest tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight soon building slight or moderate this afternoon becoming slight again overnight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, then occasional rain overnight. Clearing to become fair later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain overnight.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 2 to 4, increasing southwest 4 or 5 Friday evening and occasionally 6 overnight into Saturday for a time.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
